name: io.github.kryptokrates/nektar
title: nektar — Verifiable Agent Memory & Knowledge Market
description: Verifiable, encrypted AI agent memory anchored on BSV with checkable answer receipts and policy-controlled knowledge trading. Zero-config testnet boot with a seeded welcome shard.

environmentVariables.name: NEKTAR_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: BSV network: testnet (default zero-config), memory, regtest, or main

environmentVariables.name: NEKTAR_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Exposed tool surface: agent (10 curated tools, default) or operator (18 tools)

environmentVariables.name: NEKTAR_WALLET
environmentVariables.description: Key custody mode: embedded (default BRC-100 SQLite) or client (BSV Desktop localhost:3321)

environmentVariables.name: NEKTAR_MARKET_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated market Hub URLs (defaults to nektar.run/hub)
